content:
Imagine creating a payment form by describing it in plain language. That is CCAvenue Forms, part of their AI Suite. Merchants describe what they need in natural language and AI creates the form, from creation and editing to preview and publishing.

The same idea shows up in WhatsApp. With P2M Magic Checkout, CCAvenue brings checkout into the WhatsApp journey, so a customer moves from interaction to payment without hopping between systems.

One is for the merchant setting things up. The other is for the customer paying.
But the same instinct runs underneath both.

Technology is becoming less about learning how a system works and more about simply telling it what you need.

That, to me, is where the interesting part of fintech begins.
